injuries.description: Permanent cosmetic disability as a result of the scars from injuries sustained in this motor accident.
source: After his examination on 16th November 1982 Dr. Nicolson concluded that the 2nd Plaintiff had a permanent cosmetic disability as a result of the scars from injuries sustained in this motor accident.

manifestations.description: Permanent cosmetic disability; scars described as "noticeable, conspicuous and unsightly".
Embarrassed to wear shorts or go swimming (used to go swimming 2 or 3 times a week during the summer before this accident).
Recurring headaches mentioned to Dr. Nicolson and for which she had been prescribed medication (pills) by a doctor in Shamshuipo.
Recurring abdominal pains mentioned to Dr. Nicolson.

treatments_received: Wounds cleaned and sutured under local anaesthesia
Treatment in Queen Elizabeth Hospital and transfer to Kowloon Hospital

losses.description: Permanent cosmetic disability resulting from scars described as "noticeable, conspicuous and unsightly" leading to cosmetic disability.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Embarrassment to wear shorts or go swimming; loss of previous swimming activity (used to swim 2 or 3 times a week).
